note: The ground of Núi Nhỏ and the cape of Nghinh Phong, Vũng Tàu (plan 0006, D3): a copy with no change of the height tiles of the Vũng Tàu game (data/geo/build/height/ of sntran/Vung_Tau). Each file X_Z.png is a tile of 256 m: 129 x 129 samples, one each 2 m; the sample of row r and column c is at the game point (256 X + 2 c, 256 Z + 2 r); its height in metres is offset + value * step. The frame of the game: X to the east, Z to the south, the height up; the origin is at Bãi Trước (the longitude and the latitude of origin). The notices of the data are in CREDITS.md.
